From: Eliot Barnes <eliot@atlasai.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — live sandbox walkthrough with our prompts

Hi Hannah,

I just signed up for the Hosted API eval and spun up a sandbox environment. I would love a short (25-30m) live walkthrough where we run a couple of our real prompts against the sandbox so I can validate latency and outputs before sharing with the team.

We're a small product org — myself (product lead) and our CTO (Priya Shah) would join. Looking for availability Tue/Wed next week in the morning Pacific.

Couple of asks:
- Can you provision a short-lived API key for the session?
- Can someone walk us through the quickstart and any rate-limit considerations for evaluation?

Thanks,
Eliot Barnes
Product Lead, Atlas AI
eliot@atlasai.com
(415) 555-0182

Hi Eliot — thanks for signing up and for the clear ask. I'm Dylan from the PLG team, and I'll get a slot on the calendar. A few quick notes:

- We can do a 25–30 minute sandbox session and provision a temp API key for the demo (valid 24 hours).
- We offer two flavors: product-oriented (features, console walkthrough) or technical smoke test (live prompt runs, latency, token billing). Which do you prefer?

Proposed windows (Pacific):
- Tue 2026-08-25 09:00–09:30
- Tue 2026-08-25 11:00–11:30
- Wed 2026-08-26 08:30–09:00

I've attached a calendar stub to hold the slot while we confirm (sandbox-invite.ics). If none of those work, send a couple alternatives. Marissa will join for the technical bits.

Best,
Dylan Brooks

[d] +1 650-555-0199
